Canine Companions is a national 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization in the U.S., dedicated to providing service dogs to adults, children and veterans with disabilities. 

We also offer facility dogs to professionals working in healthcare, criminal justice and educational settings. All our dogs and follow-up services are provided free of charge to clients in the U.S.

#servicedog #LeadWithIndependence
